Zoe: Quick PSA there's a mystery jar in the fridge labeled 'DO NOT TOUCH' but no one owns it. smells like almond butter tho. Anyone missing a jar? :thinking:
Miguel: That's mine! I left it yesterday with a ripped label. sorry, I scribbled DO NOT TOUCH because someone used it for coffee sweetener last week. my bad for the dramatic caps. :sweat_smile:
Priya: Ooops that explains the almond smear on the kettle handle. Can we have a tiny ownership tag system? initials + date?
Ethan: +1 to initials. also, FYI the bagel order comes at 9:30 tomorrow. who wants poppy seed vs everything vs plain? vote with emoji: :one: poppy, :two: everything, :three: plain.
Zoe: (:two:)
Miguel: (:one:)
Priya: (:three:)
Ethan: (:two:)
Zoe: Also, someone left a hard-boiled egg in the microwave overnight. Please don't. we have a "no overnight food in microwave" policy for stink reasons. :nose:
OpsBot: Reminder: Kitchen etiquette guideline posted on the fridge. Link: http://intra/docs/kitchen-guidelines (pinned).
Priya: For the tag idea I can make a tiny printable sheet: "Name | Date | Allergens" that people can stick under lids. simple.
Miguel: Love it. And can we add a short microwave timer etiquette note: put a Post-it with your name and pickup time? small script below: 
```
- Put name+pickup time on Post-it
- If not picked up in 3 hours, toss
- If food smells weird, toss immediately
```
Ethan: Bagel tally: poppy 1, everything 2, plain 1. Looks like everything wins. I'll order 18 (room for toppings). Anyone want vegan cream cheese?
Zoe: Yes please for vegan cc.
Priya: I'll bring a small sticker roll and a tiny marker this afternoon.
Miguel: Sorry again about the dramatic jar label. I'll bring a tiny replacement jar so we stop the mystery. ETA 16:45.
OpsBot: Event created: "Bagel Run" tomorrow 09:30. Attendees: Zoe, Miguel, Priya, Ethan.
Zoe: Thanks! Also putting a tiny note on the fridge: "Please write name/date on leftovers". Closing thread once bagels delivered tomorrow. :bagel:
